description: This file defines a set of asynchronous functions for a question-answering (QA) system using an agent router, including synthesis, retrieval, and document aggregation logic. It handles prompts construction, citation management, and refinement of answers based on retrieved documentation chunks or documents.

classes.name: AgentRouter
classes.description: A class that manages reasoning components for an agent, including registered reasoners and AI interactions.

methods.name: DocAnswer synthesize_answer( question: str, results: List[RetrievalResult], is_refinement: bool = False, )
methods.description: Generates an answer with optional self-assessment and citation formatting, based on retrieved results.

methods.name: DocAnswer qa_answer( question: str, namespace: str = "website-docs", top_k: int = 6, min_score: float = 0.35, )
methods.description: Main orchestrator that plans queries, retrieves relevant chunks, and synthesizes an answer, with optional refinement.

methods.name: DocAnswer qa_answer_with_documents( question: str, namespace: str = "website-docs", top_k: int = 6, min_score: float = 0.35, top_documents: int = 5, )
methods.description: QA process that retrieves full documents instead of chunks, integrating them into the answer and refining if needed.
